      About this item

      • Purify your hair with L’OREAL PARIS HYALURON PURE 72H PURIFYING SHAMPOO, enriched with salicylic and hyaluronic acid for deep care.
      • Effectively removes impurities from oily scalp while hydrating dry, dehydrated hair, leaving your hair feeling refreshed.
      • Guarantees 72 hours of fresh scalp and hydrated hair, keeping your hair looking healthy and full of movement.
      • Visible results from Day 1, as your hair appears shinier, healthier, and more vibrant after just one use.
      • Complete your hair care routine by combining this shampoo with the Hyaluron Pure conditioner for optimal hydration and shine

      Important information

      Safety Information:

      For external use only.

      Ingredients:

      AQUA / WATER ● SODIUM LAURETH SULFATE ● COCAMIDOPROPYL BETAINE ● PARFUM / FRAGRANCE ● COCAMIDE MEA ● SODIUM CHLORIDE ● SODIUM BENZOATE ● SODIUM HYDROXIDE ● HYDROXYPROPYL GUAR HYDROXYPROPYLTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE ● SODIUM HYALURONATE ● SALICYLIC ACID ● LIMONENE ● CITRIC ACID ● HEXYLENE GLYCOL ●

      Directions:

      Step 1: Apply L’Oréal Paris Hyaluron Pure 72H Purifying Shampoo on wet hair. Massage your scalp, cleansing from roots to tips. This step removes 99% of excess oil, leaving your scalp feeling refreshed and clean without irritation. Step 2: Finish with L’Oréal Paris Hyaluron Pure Rehydrating Conditioner on wet hair, focusing on lengths and dry ends. Leave the product on for one minute, then rinse to detangle and lock in moisture, ensuring your hair feels instantly hydrated and nourished. In case of contact with eyes, rinse immediately and thoroughly

      L’Oréal Paris Hyaluron Pure 72H Purifying Shampoo, For oily scalp & dry hair with salicylic and hyaluronic acid, 340 ml

      Product description

      New L’Oréal Paris Hyaluron Pure 72H Purifying Shampoo deeply cleanses oily scalp and hydrates dry, dehydrated hair. Enriched with salicylic and hyaluronic acid, this purifying shampoo effectively removes excess oil from scalp while providing lasting hydration to dry, dehydrated lengths, leaving your hair feeling refreshed and revitalized.This L’Oréal Hyaluron Pure purifying shampoo effectively removes 99% of excess oil, deeply cleansing the scalp without irritating or damaging the hair fiber. From Day 1, you'll notice visible results as your hair begins to look healthier, shinier, and full of movement. For best results, pair it with the Hyaluron Pure conditioner to complete your hair care routine.

      About this Item

      • Purify your hair with L’OREAL PARIS HYALURON PURE 72H PURIFYING SHAMPOO, enriched with salicylic and hyaluronic acid for deep care.
      • Effectively removes impurities from oily scalp while hydrating dry, dehydrated hair, leaving your hair feeling refreshed.
      • Guarantees 72 hours of fresh scalp and hydrated hair, keeping your hair looking healthy and full of movement.
      • Visible results from Day 1, as your hair appears shinier, healthier, and more vibrant after just one use.
      • Complete your hair care routine by combining this shampoo with the Hyaluron Pure conditioner for optimal hydration and shine

      Product description

      New L’Oréal Paris Hyaluron Pure 72H Purifying Shampoo deeply cleanses oily scalp and hydrates dry, dehydrated hair. Enriched with salicylic and hyaluronic acid, this purifying shampoo effectively removes excess oil from scalp while providing lasting hydration to dry, dehydrated lengths, leaving your hair feeling refreshed and revitalized.This L’Oréal Hyaluron Pure purifying shampoo effectively removes 99% of excess oil, deeply cleansing the scalp without irritating or damaging the hair fiber. From Day 1, you'll notice visible results as your hair begins to look healthier, shinier, and full of movement. For best results, pair it with the Hyaluron Pure conditioner to complete your hair care routine.

      Important Information

      Safety Information:

      For external use only.

      Ingredients:

      AQUA / WATER ● SODIUM LAURETH SULFATE ● COCAMIDOPROPYL BETAINE ● PARFUM / FRAGRANCE ● COCAMIDE MEA ● SODIUM CHLORIDE ● SODIUM BENZOATE ● SODIUM HYDROXIDE ● HYDROXYPROPYL GUAR HYDROXYPROPYLTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE ● SODIUM HYALURONATE ● SALICYLIC ACID ● LIMONENE ● CITRIC ACID ● HEXYLENE GLYCOL ●

      Directions:

      Step 1: Apply L’Oréal Paris Hyaluron Pure 72H Purifying Shampoo on wet hair. Massage your scalp, cleansing from roots to tips. This step removes 99% of excess oil, leaving your scalp feeling refreshed and clean without irritation. Step 2: Finish with L’Oréal Paris Hyaluron Pure Rehydrating Conditioner on wet hair, focusing on lengths and dry ends. Leave the product on for one minute, then rinse to detangle and lock in moisture, ensuring your hair feels instantly hydrated and nourished. In case of contact with eyes, rinse immediately and thoroughly
